'''Tai'ya Rocca''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] who was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Rocca was stationed in [[Outpost Thorazan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He tasked a Republic spacer to rescue several ambassadors from a warlord.<ref name="TOR" />
